news.headline: Harrow Ophthalmic Portfolio Highlighted in 15 Scientific Presentations at AAOpt and AAO
news.summary: Harrow will present 15 abstracts (13 at AAOpt, Sept 30-Oct 3; 2 at AAO, Oct 9-12) covering VEVYE, VERKAZIA, FLAREX and BYQLOVI, including Phase 3 and 52-week long-term safety data.

news.headline: Harrow announces IHEEZO data on patient-reported discomfort after intravitreal injections
news.summary: Harrow highlighted clinical evidence for IHEEZO and BYOOVIZ at the ASRS 2026 annual meeting, including data on patient-reported discomfort around intravitreal injections.

news.headline: Harrow Q2 2026 earnings call: VEVYE record revenue, G-MELT pre-NDA planned for early Q4
news.summary: Management reiterated 2026 guidance of $350-365M revenue and $80-100M adjusted EBITDA, implying a strong second half. A pre-NDA meeting for G-MELT is planned for early Q4 2026 with NDA submission targeted for 1H 2027.

news.headline: Harrow Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Revenue was $70.7M, up 11% year over year and 60% sequentially, with VEVYE at $29.4M (+58% YoY). The net loss was $17.3M ($0.46 per share), wider than analysts expected.

news.headline: Harrow to acquire global rights to TYRVAYA for $30 million
news.summary: Harrow agreed to buy global rights to TYRVAYA for $30M in cash, expected to close in 2H 2026, with over $30M of revenue anticipated in 2027. The company also launched BYOOVIZ and expanded its commercial organization.

catalysts.label: AAO presentations (New Orleans)
catalysts.detail: Two of the 15 abstracts will be presented at the AAO annual meeting.

catalysts.label: G-MELT (MELT-300) pre-NDA meeting with FDA
catalysts.detail: Pre-NDA meeting scheduled early in Q4 2026; NDA submission targeted for 1H 2027.

catalysts.label: TYRVAYA acquisition closing
catalysts.detail: $30M cash purchase of global rights, expected to close in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results; the guidance of $350-365M revenue implies roughly $235-250M in 2H, so Q3 delivery is the key test. Date not yet confirmed.

catalysts.label: Launch of late-stage assets (G-MELT, YOCHIL)
catalysts.detail: Harrow intends to launch G-MELT and YOCHIL (formerly MELT-210) beginning in 2028.

pulse: Harrow reported Q2 revenue of $70.7M (+11% YoY) with VEVYE at a record $29.4M, but a wider-than-expected loss, and reiterated 2026 guidance of $350-365M revenue and $80-100M adjusted EBITDA, which leans heavily on 2H. Near-term focus is the G-MELT pre-NDA meeting in early Q4, the TYRVAYA deal closing and the AAOpt/AAO data flow.
